enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the KernelScan data source should be enabled.

feedBaseUrl.title: Feed Base URL
feedBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the KernelScan feed.

feedToken.title: Feed Token
feedToken.description: KernelScan feed URL token (`kf_pub_…`). Minted per account at kernelscan.io (Account → Feed).

incrementalMirroringEnabled.title: Incremental Mirroring Enabled
incrementalMirroringEnabled.description: When enabled (default), a watermark is kept and only new or updated CVE records are mirrored on each run. When disabled, the full kernel CVE corpus is re-mirrored every run.
